epic.title: Teacher Student Management & Profile Module
epic.body: Provides teachers with a comprehensive view of their students, including class-wise analytics, search capabilities, and detailed individual profiles covering academic performance, attendance, and conduct.

features.title: Class-wise Student Analytics & Search
features.body: Interface for teachers to browse students by class and view aggregate performance metrics.

stories.title: Student List & Search Interface
stories.body: Implement the student directory UI including class dropdown, search bar, and student cards/list with navigation to profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown to select class (e.g., 7A, 8B) triggers list refresh
Search bar filters students by name or roll number in real-time
Each student card displays name, roll number, and avatar
Clicking a student navigates to the detailed profile view

stories.title: Class Analytics Cards
stories.body: Build the top-level summary cards showing aggregate data for the selected class.
acceptanceCriteria: Display 'Total Students' card with count
Display 'Avg Marks' card with percentage
Display 'Avg Attendance' card with percentage
Cards update dynamically based on the selected class

stories.title: Student Directory & Analytics API
stories.body: API endpoints to serve student lists and calculated metrics for the teacher's classes.
acceptanceCriteria: GET endpoint to retrieve students by classId (List operation)
GET endpoint to return calculated averages (marks/attendance) for a specific class
Ensure results are scoped only to classes assigned to the requesting teacher

features.title: 360-Degree Student Profile
features.body: Detailed view of an individual student's records including personal info, exams, and attendance.

stories.title: Profile Header & Navigation Tabs
stories.body: Implement the core layout of the student profile page with personal info and tab switching.
acceptanceCriteria: Header displays profile picture, name, roll number, and parent contact details
Navigation tabs for: Overview, Exams, Attendance, and Conduct
Overview tab shows quick status cards (Current Rank, Attendance %)

stories.title: Exam Results & Attendance History UI
stories.body: Build the detailed views for exam performance cards and attendance logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Exams tab shows cards with Total Marks, Obtained Marks, and Subject-wise breakdown
Attendance tab shows a chronological list of recent status records (Present/Absent/Late) with dates
Data is displayed via read-only lists and tables

stories.title: Student Performance & History API
stories.body: Endpoints to serve specific historical data for a single student.
acceptanceCriteria: GET endpoint for student personal/contact overview
GET endpoint for exam result history (multi-exam support)
GET endpoint for detailed attendance logs (list operation)

features.title: Behavioral Remarks & Conduct
features.body: Management of behavioral feedback and teacher-parent communication.

stories.title: Conduct Timeline & Remark CRUD UI
stories.body: Implementation of the behavioral remarks timeline and the ability to add/edit/delete remarks.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeline view of all historical remarks (List)
Create: Modal to add new remark with Type (Academic/Discipline/Attitude) and Text
Update: Ability to edit an existing remark author by the teacher
Delete: Ability to remove a remark with confirmation prompt
Threaded View: Option to expand remarks to see comments

stories.title: Behavioral Remarks API
stories.body: Full CRUD API for managing student conduct records and feedback threads.
acceptanceCriteria: POST to create new remark
GET to list remarks for a specific studentId
PUT/PATCH to update remark content
DELETE to remove a remark
POST/GET endpoints for comment threads on individual remarks
